sibling_emails = {contact['email'].lower() for contact in sibling_contacts}
yesterday_start = datetime.combine(yesterday_date, datetime.min.time())
yesterday_end = datetime.combine(yesterday_date, datetime.max.time())

social_feed = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_social_feed(
        access_token=venmo_access_token,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    social_feed.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

target_transactions = [
    transaction for transaction in social_feed
    if yesterday_start <= datetime.fromisoformat(transaction['created_at']) <= yesterday_end
    and (
        transaction['sender']['email'].lower() in sibling_emails
        or transaction['receiver']['email'].lower() in sibling_emails
    )
]
target_transaction_ids = sorted({transaction['transaction_id'] for transaction in target_transactions})
print(target_transactions)
print('Transaction IDs to like:', target_transaction_ids)
